modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Shifts the trunk forward over both planted soles.
modes.minus: Shifts the trunk backward over both planted soles.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Shifts the trunk left over the planted soles.
modes.minus: Shifts the trunk right over the planted soles.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Lowers the trunk by folding both legs while keeping both soles planted.
modes.minus: Slightly raises the trunk by extending both knees.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Rolls the trunk toward the left while both soles remain planted.
modes.minus: Rolls the trunk toward the right while both soles remain planted.

modes.name: trunk_pitch_forward
modes.plus: Pitches the upper trunk forward, with compensating leg motion over planted soles.
modes.minus: Pitches the upper trunk backward.

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Turns the trunk left above the planted soles.
modes.minus: Turns the trunk right above the planted soles.

modes.name: left_sole_forward
modes.plus: Lifts the left sole forward of its home position.
modes.minus: Lifts the left sole backward of its home position.

modes.name: right_sole_forward
modes.plus: Lifts the right sole forward of its home position.
modes.minus: Lifts the right sole backward of its home position.

modes.name: left_sole_outward
modes.plus: Lifts and spreads the left sole toward the left, turning it outward.
modes.minus: Lifts the left sole slightly inward and turns it inward.

modes.name: right_sole_outward
modes.plus: Lifts and spreads the right sole toward the right, turning it outward.
modes.minus: Lifts the right sole slightly inward and turns it inward.

modes.name: left_sole_up
modes.plus: Draws the left sole upward by deeply folding the knee and hip.
modes.minus: Raises the left sole behind the hip with a shallower knee fold.

modes.name: right_sole_up
modes.plus: Draws the right sole upward by deeply folding the knee and hip.
modes.minus: Raises the right sole behind the hip with a shallower knee fold.

modes.name: left_wrist_up
modes.plus: Raises the left wrist through a forward-to-overhead arc.
modes.minus: Sweeps the left wrist downward and backward.

modes.name: right_wrist_up
modes.plus: Raises the right wrist through a forward-to-overhead arc.
modes.minus: Sweeps the right wrist downward and backward.

modes.name: left_wrist_outward
modes.plus: Spreads and raises the left wrist toward the left.
modes.minus: Brings the left wrist inward on a raised, folded-arm arc.

modes.name: right_wrist_outward
modes.plus: Spreads and raises the right wrist toward the right.
modes.minus: Brings the right wrist inward on a raised, folded-arm arc.

modes.name: left_wrist_fold_down
modes.plus: Folds the left elbow to draw the wrist downward and inward in reach.
modes.minus: Extends the left elbow and raises the wrist.

modes.name: right_wrist_fold_down
modes.plus: Folds the right elbow to draw the wrist downward and inward in reach.
modes.minus: Extends the right elbow and raises the wrist.

modes.name: left_wrist_sweep_left
modes.plus: Sweeps the left wrist leftward around the shoulder.
modes.minus: Sweeps the left wrist rightward with the arm raised clear of the trunk.

modes.name: right_wrist_sweep_right
modes.plus: Sweeps the right wrist rightward around the shoulder.
modes.minus: Sweeps the right wrist leftward with the arm raised clear of the trunk.

modes.name: left_wrist_rotate
modes.plus: Rolls the left wrist positively while pitching and yawing its tip downward and left.
modes.minus: Reverses the wrist rotation, pitching and yawing its tip upward and right.

modes.name: right_wrist_rotate
modes.plus: Rolls the right wrist negatively while pitching and yawing its tip downward and right.
modes.minus: Reverses the wrist rotation, pitching and yawing its tip upward and left.
